observable_outcome: M4 stop and recovery is complete and provable in a local closure. A control intent terminates a real Runner process group and the Control Plane reaches ControlVerified only from a durable per-runner observation, never by inference; an unreachable runner past the deadline becomes blocked-unreachable and an ambiguous external effect becomes blocked-ambiguous. A partition Runner is fenced by the reconciler and its old Renew, Checkpoint and AcceptResult are all rejected while the canonical state stays unchanged and the next claim takes a strictly greater fencing token. Claim, integration, promotion, preview-deploy and intake are all denied through the real application service and the real outbox dispatcher over a store under pause-intake, pause-claim, graceful, immediate and emergency stop and cancel, with checkpoint the only operation graceful stop still allows. The two measured non-convergence defects are fixed: a terminal Execution behind an expired active Lease no longer aborts every reconcile pass forever, and an Execution orphaned by a lease reclaim is both no longer created and swept if already present. Failure injection is finite and exhaustive: the 17 documented failure classes and the 12 documented injection scenarios are each enumerated, totalled against a named constant and partitioned into converges-here, converged-elsewhere and deferred with an owning task named for every deferral. One reconcile tick stays bounded at 100 items with a working continuation cursor. devbox run --pure -- make check is green on the committed tree with .agents/v2/evidence/V2-019-reconciler.json registered in .agents/v2/evidence/index.json.
acceptance_criteria: A1. Every pre-existing test in the three touched Go packages still exists under the same name and still passes. Measured pre-change counts on HEAD 576019e with devbox run --pure -- go test -count=1 -v: internal/reconciler 3 (TestTickExpiresLeaseAndFencesLostExecution, TestVerifyControlFailsClosedForMixedReachabilityAndAmbiguity, TestVerificationReconcilerPersistsVerifiedEvidence), internal/application 26, internal/runner 30. Do not rename, rewrite or re-prove any of them. State the before and after count for each package in the evidence summary. Do not add any test that re-derives a V2-010 domain-closure claim: expired-fence non-advancement, stop-denied effect construction and the forbidden-transition set are already proven at the domain layer and re-asserting them here is a weaker second witness, not coverage.

A2. Reproduce the poison-pill defect as a failing test first, then fix it. Seed a Lease with Status LeaseActive and ExpiresAt in the past whose Execution is already ExecutionSucceeded, plus a second, genuinely recoverable expired Lease whose lease id sorts strictly after the first. Before the fix, assert the measured behaviour: Reconciler.Tick returns an error wrapping domain.ErrInvalidTransition, report is {Scanned:2 Recovered:0 Skipped:0}, the poison Lease is still LeaseActive and the recoverable Execution is still ExecutionRunning, and three consecutive Ticks reproduce it identically. After the fix, assert that the pass completes with no error, that the terminal Execution's status is unchanged, that its Lease is LeaseExpired, and that the recoverable Execution reached ExecutionLost with its increment back to ready. The counter used for the terminal candidate must be distinguishable in Report from a genuine recovery.

A3. Reconciler.Tick classifies per-item outcomes explicitly and never loops on one. Assert with a table that domain.ErrStaleVersion and domain.ErrStaleFence are skipped, that a terminal Execution is accounted separately per A2, and that quota.ErrOverBudget from ReserveQuota still aborts the pass and is returned to the caller unwrapped enough for errors.Is to match. Do not make Tick tolerant of every error: state in the work report that swallowing ErrOverBudget would convert a hard Budget stop into a silent partial sweep and violate the safety invariant that no new resource consumption starts after a hard Budget overrun.

A4. Orphan Executions converge, and are no longer created. Source half: Service.Claim's reclaim branch must terminate the superseded Execution inside the same transaction it expires the superseded Lease in, using the Execution already reachable through ExecutionByLease, and must record it. Extend TestExpiredLeaseCanBeReclaimed's coverage with a new assertion (a new test function, not a rewrite) that the first Execution is no longer non-terminal after the second Claim. Sweep half: a bounded orphan pass finds a non-terminal Execution whose bound Lease is absent, expired or revoked and drives it to a terminal state with the current fencing token retained. Measured precondition to reproduce first: with a Lease already LeaseExpired and its Execution still ExecutionRunning, Reconciler.Tick today reports {Scanned:0 Recovered:0} and the Execution stays running forever, because ExpiredActiveLeases filters lease_status == active and recoverOne re-checks lease.Status != LeaseActive.

A5. The orphan sweep adds no repository port and no store change. It composes only ports that already exist in both stores: RequirementsPage(afterID, limit), IncrementsForRequirements(ids), ExecutionsForIncrements(ids) and Lease(id) (measured at internal/store/memory/store.go lines 141, 174, 189 and internal/store/firestore/store.go lines 451, 516, 547). Assert the sweep is cursor-paged and never returns more than reconciler.MaxBatch items in one pass. If the sweep appears to require a new UnitOfWork method, stop and escalate: UnitOfWork embeds the repository interfaces, so the addition is not optional once declared and it pulls store-memory and store-firestore plus a new Firestore index into the blast radius.

A6. The reconcile tick ceiling from docs/architecture/validation.md section 5 is asserted structurally. Over 150 expired candidates, assert the first Tick recovers exactly reconciler.MaxBatch = 100 and returns a non-empty cursor, the continuation Tick recovers the remaining 50 and returns an empty cursor, no candidate is recovered twice, and both Ticks complete inside a context.WithTimeout of 30 seconds with t.Fatal on expiry. Do not assert a wall-clock duration threshold. Record the measured duration in the evidence as an observation; the pre-change measurement on the memory store was 10.7 ms for 150 candidates over two passes.

A7. Journey 4's partition segment is one self-contained test function with its own fixtures, its own context deadline and no package-level mutable state: a Runner holds an active Lease and a running Execution, the injected clock advances past the Lease TTL without a renewal, the reconciler tick fences (Lease expired, Execution lost, increment back to ready, fencing token retained), a different Runner claims and receives a strictly greater fencing token, and then the partitioned Runner's Renew, Checkpoint and AcceptResult submitted under its old lease id, version, control revision and fencing token are each rejected with a specific domain error. Assert per call which error, and assert the new Execution's canonical state is byte-identical before and after each rejected call. This is the partition path; do not duplicate V2-016's crash path (TestJourneyFourLocalCrashResumeAcrossExecutions), and say in the work report which of the two carries which claim.

A8. Journey 5 is one self-contained test function per stop mode family covering the whole failure-model.md section 5 protocol for a connected Runner: the Control Intent is durably written and ControlProgress starts at ControlRequested with VerificationPending; new claim and credential issuance stop; the Runner acks the revision through Heartbeat and the progress advances to ControlAcknowledged; the child is checkpointed under graceful stop and terminated under immediate and emergency stop; the Result and outbox operations reconcile; and only then does the verification reconciler reach ControlVerified with no active Lease remaining. Assert the fail-closed directions in the same journey: a missing observation stays VerificationPending before the deadline and becomes VerificationBlockedUnreachable after it, a mixed reachable/unreachable target set never verifies, and an ambiguous outbox resolution yields VerificationBlockedAmbiguous ahead of any success-looking process report. Do not assert ControlVerified from an intent alone.

A9. A control intent causes a real process group to die, and that is proven with a real signal. Wire ControlLoop.StopProcess to a real ProcessSupervisor cancellation in a new runner test: the test re-executes its own binary as a child (os.Args[0] plus a helper environment variable), the child spawns a grandchild in the same new process group, both write marker files, the parent polls for both markers under a bounded deadline with t.Fatal on timeout, then ControlLoop.Apply with domain.ControlImmediateStop is invoked and the test asserts that TERM was delivered before KILL, that both child and grandchild are actually gone (observed through files they write, polled under a bounded deadline), and that the journal records a control_observation whose state is terminated. Do not modify internal/runner/supervisor.go or supervisor_test.go: that test already proves group termination on context cancellation and V2-016 already strengthened it. State in the work report why V2-016 was not sufficient: ControlLoop is referenced nowhere outside its own test file, so StopProcess has only ever been a fake, and TestJournalSurvivesRealSIGKILLOfProcessGroup kills from outside rather than from a control intent.

A10. A runner-side ControlAgent closes the observation loop. LifecycleResponse gains one additive field, LatestMode (json latest_mode), carrying the effective domain.ControlMode; contracts/openapi/openapi-v1.yaml gains one optional latest_mode property (type string, no enum, Go struct tag omitempty) on the LifecycleResponse schema only, which is the response of heartbeat and of checkpoint; RenewResponse is a different schema carrying lease_id, expires_at and version and must not be touched, and nothing else in that file changes. ControlAgent turns (LatestRevision, LatestMode) into a domain.ControlIntent when LatestRevision exceeds the applied revision, applies it through ControlLoop, and LeaseKeeper.Tick then sends HeartbeatRequest{ControlRevision: applied, Processes: [{ProcessID: executionID, State: terminated|checkpointed}]}. Assert that with the agent wired the verification reconciler reaches ControlVerified and that with the agent absent it stays VerificationPending, which is the positive control proving the observation is what advances the state. The agent is driven only by explicit Tick calls; no background goroutine and no timer. No internal/api change is required because the heartbeat handler already writes the application struct directly with writeJSON(w, 200, out). Additionally assert the fail-closed direction with a negative test: when LatestRevision exceeds the applied revision and latest_mode is absent or carries an unknown value, the Runner treats it as a fail-closed stop. Without that test the property is not safely optional.

A11. Runner reconnect reconciliation refuses new work until the prior Execution is reported. After a restart, replaying the journal must surface an unreconciled prior Execution, and while one is present the Runner must refuse to obtain a new claim, with an explicit error rather than a silent skip. Assert both directions: refused while unreconciled, allowed once reported. Do not add a workspace garbage collector and do not add an OS-level sandbox; OS-enforced workspace confinement is owned by V2-046.

A12. Stop denies claim, integration, promotion, preview-deploy and intake through the real application surface over a store, not through a hand-built domain.PermitDecision. Build a mode-by-kind matrix over the 7 control modes (allow, pause-intake, pause-claim, graceful-stop, immediate-stop, emergency-stop, cancel) driving Service.Capture, Service.Claim, Service.Checkpoint, Service.AcceptResult, Service.Permit and OutboxDispatcher items whose PermitKind is integration, promotion, preview-deploy and external-effect. Assert the expected outcome for every cell against a named-constant total, assert that checkpoint is the only operation graceful-stop still allows, and assert that no sink invocation and no durable effect record is produced for any denied cell. pause-claim is currently covered by no test at all and must be covered here. State in the work report what is NOT claimed: no canonical integration operation and no canonical promotion operation exists yet, so this proves that the store-backed permit evaluation and the dispatcher deny those kinds, not that a promotion saga was stopped mid-flight; that is owned by V2-022 (M5 live).

A13. Failure injection is finitized as two exhaustive tables in internal/reconciler test code. Table 1 enumerates the failure taxonomy of docs/architecture/failure-model.md section 2 with wantDocumentedFailureClassCount = 17 asserted against a named constant, partitioned exhaustively into convergesHere = 5 (policy-denied, execution-lost, progress-stalled, external-ambiguous, unknown), convergedElsewhere = 4 (invalid-input, capacity-unavailable, provider-transport, budget-exceeded), deferred = 8 (provider-model, provider-quota, verification-failed, integration-conflict, preview-regression, promotion-partial, secret-suspected, contract-incompatible). Table 2 enumerates section 10 with wantInjectionScenarioCount = 12, partitioned into injectedHere = 5, injectedElsewhere = 2, deferred = 5 exactly as listed in dp-v2-019 d8. Every convergedElsewhere and injectedElsewhere row must name the existing test that carries it and every deferred row must name the owning task and milestone. The buckets must be asserted to sum to the constant and to be disjoint, so a scenario cannot be silently reclassified. Each convergesHere and injectedHere row must state its convergence observable in one sentence and must be linked to the test function that observes it. The owner of every deferred row is fixed as follows and must be recorded verbatim: provider-model to V2-027, provider-quota to V2-027 with the live probe in V2-028, verification-failed to V2-030, integration-conflict to V2-022, preview-regression to V2-022, promotion-partial to V2-022, secret-suspected to V2-017, contract-incompatible to V2-034; for the injection table, quota exhaustion and recovery to V2-028, Preview deploy mid-failure to V2-022, docs-routing-only failure to V2-022, schema migration restart to V2-034, capacity starvation to V2-030. A deferred row may only name a task whose status in .agents/v2/task-state is not complete; naming a completed task is a deferral to nobody and fails this criterion. V2-021 is complete and must not appear as an owner.

A14. The three-class drift between the documented taxonomy and the code is recorded, not silently absorbed. Assert in the same table test that domain.FailureClass declares exactly 14 constants, that exactly three documented classes (promotion-partial, secret-suspected, contract-incompatible) have no domain constant, and that all three fall in the deferred bucket. Do not add the missing constants: internal/domain non-test files are prohibited and the M1 gate proved closure over exactly those files. Record the drift in the evidence and in the work report with V2-049 named as the owning task. The record must also state in one sentence that internal/provider declares its own separate FailureClass type, which carries values such as contract-incompatible and timeout, and that it is a different taxonomy from the domain one rather than a duplicate.

A15. Ambiguous external operation handling gains its missing step and its missing branches. Implement step 1 of failure-model.md section 6 (consult the local record for the same Operation ID before reading the external system) so an item already Confirmed or Delivered is never re-observed, and assert it with a counting observer. Assert all three resolutions from a single ambiguous item: Confirmed converges to OutboxConfirmed with DeliveredAt set, NotObserved retries under the identical immutable operation and idempotency key with no second key ever generated, and an unknown observation converges to OutboxNeedsInput without any redelivery. Do not re-design the classifier or the observer seam; TestOutboxAmbiguousRequiresObservationBeforeAnyRedelivery and TestVerifyControlFailsClosedForMixedReachabilityAndAmbiguity already carry the mechanism and must keep passing unchanged.

A16. No file outside allowed_paths changes. In particular ci/components.json, Makefile, go.mod, go.sum, devbox.json and devbox.lock are untouched, because internal/ci/planner.go evidenceKey() hashes ci/components.json, go.mod, go.sum and devbox.lock into every component's evidence key, so touching any of them invalidates all 23 component keys and every committed evidence record. test/journeys/ is not created: ci.ValidateTracked requires exactly one owning component per tracked file, so it cannot exist without the prohibited ci/components.json edit and make ownership, part of make check, would fail. internal/store/**, internal/api/**, internal/release/**, internal/provider/**, cmd/** and every internal/domain non-test file are untouched. Under docs/, only docs/operations/reconciliation.md and docs/operations/control-verification.md change; docs/architecture/** and docs/operations/runner-local.md are held open by another implementer.

A17. docs/operations/reconciliation.md and docs/operations/control-verification.md are updated to match the implementation and say nothing the code does not do. reconciliation.md must state the per-item outcome classification including the terminal-Execution case and that a hard Budget overrun still stops the pass, the orphan sweep and the ports it composes, the 100-item cursor bound, and the local-record short-circuit before any external read. control-verification.md must state that the Runner acks the revision and reports process observations through Heartbeat, that LatestMode is what lets the Runner choose checkpoint over terminate, and that verification advances only from a durable observation. Japanese prose, English identifiers.

A18. Exactly one evidence record is created: .agents/v2/evidence/V2-019-reconciler.json with id ev-v2-019-reconciler, task_id V2-019 (the producer), component reconciler and result passed, holding one check per acceptance item above with the argv actually executed and its timeout. Its evidence_key is the reconciler component key read with devbox run --pure -- make evidence-keys on the final tree at which devbox run --pure -- make check, format included, is green, because a formatting-only change moves the key and because evidenceKey() reads git ls-files, so a new file that has not been git added is missing from the key's input set. The record is registered in .agents/v2/evidence/index.json with evidence_hash equal to the sha256 of the record file's bytes, and devbox run --pure -- go test -count=1 ./internal/contracts is green. That pair, registered in the index and the ledger test green, is the definition of done, not merely that the tests passed.

A19. The record must additionally carry, as measured notes rather than as component evidence: the argv and result of make component-runner, make component-application and make component-api, because the reconciler check target is 'go test ./internal/reconciler ./internal/application ./internal/domain' and does not run internal/runner; and the fact that ev-v2-016-runner's evidence_key is now stale because internal/runner changed, with the reason that internal/ci/planner.go evidenceKey() covers a component's own roots. Do not edit .agents/v2/evidence/V2-016-runner.json and do not create a second evidence record. If the M4 gate requires a fresh runner component record, stop and escalate to product_orchestrator: that is a second entry in an index two other implementers hold open. The staleness note must be complete rather than partial: editing contracts/openapi/openapi-v1.yaml also makes ev-v2-025-contracts and ev-v2-047-provider-preflight-contract stale, because the contracts component's roots cover contracts/**, and ev-v2-009-release-contract and ev-v2-021-release stale as well, because the release component depends on contracts and evidenceKey includes a dependency's public contracts. A20. After committing the evidence, devbox run --pure -- make check is green on the committed state, because gitleaks git scans committed history and never scans an uncommitted working tree. Checkpoints are pushed one at a time and the parent commit's v2 selective CI is confirmed green before the next push, per docs/operations/v2-task-dag.md section 10.

A21. No acceptance item is reported as passed unless its argv was actually executed in this task. No claim here substitutes for another task: the work report must state explicitly that no real Provider CLI was started, no Google Cloud resource was touched, no Provider quota was consumed, no injected failure produced an external side effect, and that Preview deploy failure and docs-routing-only failure remain owned by V2-022, schema-migration restart by V2-034, Provider quota exhaustion recovery by V2-028, multi-Repository capacity starvation by V2-030 and OS-enforced workspace confinement by V2-046, and all of them remain untouched here.
constraints: Local closure only. Do not invoke codex, claude or opencode, do not start any real Provider CLI, do not consume Provider quota, do not touch any Google Cloud resource, and do not read any real credential from the environment, an OS keyring or disk. Every injected failure must be injected through an in-process fake or an injected clock; failure injection must not reach any external system.

Determinism is an acceptance property, not a preference. No fixed sleep, no wall-clock dependence, no background timer or goroutine, and no dependence on another test's execution order or residual processes. Synchronise with a real child process only on an observable file or state under a bounded deadline with t.Fatal on timeout. If a test cannot be made deterministic, stop and escalate; do not quarantine it and do not retry it into a pass, because docs/architecture/validation.md section 9 forbids promoting a result that varied.

internal/domain non-test files and contracts/schemas/** are prohibited. The M1 gate proved closure over exactly those files. If the work appears to need a new domain type, a new PermitKind, a new FailureClass constant or a schema field, stop and escalate with the exact identifier and the reason. The known candidate is real and is already handled by A14 without a domain edit: three documented failure classes have no domain.FailureClass constant.

The only permitted contract change is the single additive optional latest_mode property in contracts/openapi/openapi-v1.yaml described in A10. Any removal, rename or semantic change to that document, or any other schema change, is an escalation to product_orchestrator, not a decision. If product_orchestrator refuses the additive field, switch to the recorded fallback (the Runner treats any unapplied revision as a fail-closed stop) and rewrite the affected acceptance items before implementing, rather than patching afterwards.

internal/store/**, internal/api/**, internal/release/**, internal/provider/**, internal/scheduler/** and cmd/** are prohibited. The orphan sweep composes read ports that already exist in both stores and the heartbeat handler already marshals the application response struct directly, so none of these needs to move. If one appears to, stop and escalate rather than widening the blast radius.

Do not create test/journeys/ and do not edit ci/components.json. If the work appears to require a new component, stop and escalate to product_orchestrator: ci/** is in all_on_change and ci/components.json is hashed into every component's evidence key, so the change invalidates the M0, M1 and M3 gate evidence while two other implementers hold .agents/v2/evidence/** open.
Do not write any task-state file. Sol owns every .agents/v2/task-state transition and the coordinator edits that directory concurrently. Report the exact block_reason string instead.

.agents/v2/evidence/index.json is being edited concurrently. Add only the single ev-v2-019-reconciler entry, never rewrite or reorder another task's entry, and after any rebase recompute evidence_hash on the final bytes of the record file before declaring the ledger test green.

A second Terra holds .agents/v2/packets/V2-021-*.json and a second Luna holds docs/architecture/technology.md, docs/architecture/validation.md, docs/operations/runner-local.md and .agents/v2/evidence/** open. Touch none of them.

Reproduce before fixing. A2 and A4 both name defects measured on HEAD 576019e with go test -overlay; each must first be reproduced as a failing assertion in the committed test suite and only then fixed, so the test is proven to bind. A fix landed without a reproduced failure is not accepted, because V2-016 already recorded a case where an assertion passed even with the behaviour it claimed to check removed.

Escalate to tech_lead, do not guess: any acceptance item whose target boundary, observable or validation entry point is unclear, and any second consecutive failure of the same acceptance item. The retry budget for this task is 2 attempts.

Rollback is a single git revert of this task's checkpoint commits. No external state, no cloud resource and no credential is created, so nothing outside the repository needs undoing; the only side effects are files under the allowed paths. If the additive openapi field has already been pushed when a revert is needed, revert it in the same commit range so the contract and the code never disagree on a pushed tree.
Work only inside the assigned isolated task worktree. Do not commit or push outside it; the coordinator pushes checkpoints one at a time and waits for the parent commit's CI.
Japanese for the tracked documents; English identifiers in code, schemas and configuration.

All three escalations raised while drafting this Work Order are ruled. The additive latest_mode property is accepted on the LifecycleResponse schema only, with a fail-closed negative test required. The M4 gate accepts the single reconciler evidence record; the runner key staleness is resolved by V2-045 and the gate re-runs make component-runner at judgement time under the new rule G6 rather than demanding a second evidence entry. The enumeration buckets stand as drafted, with every deferred owner fixed by A13. Do not re-open any of them; escalate a new question of the same kind instead.
